anchor_quote: A significant negative correlation exists between the % of baseline Ki and increase in PTK/ZK oral dose and plasma levels
anchor_detail: Two phase I studies, 26 colorectal-cancer patients with liver metastases: DCE-MRI Ki fell dose- and exposure-dependently under VEGFR TKI PTK787/ZK 222584
other_movers: any VEGF-axis agent (bevacizumab), vascular-disrupting agents, chemo/radiation necrosis, haemodynamics, scan variability
note: PTK/ZK never approved; later reproduced with approved VEGF-axis drugs; member tagged FGFR1 but DCE-MRI is VEGFR-class pharmacology, not FGFR1-specific.

anchor_quote: An important fall (mean, 3.9 log10/ml) in the log titer in 10 patients with P. aeruginosa in their respiratory secretions was observed after 5 days of treatment.
anchor_detail: Oral ciprofloxacin 500 mg q8h in 11 Pseudomonas-colonised CF patients; quantitative sputum P. aeruginosa titres fell 3.9 log10/mL by day 5
other_movers: any active antibiotic (tobramycin, aztreonam, colistin), exacerbation state, airway clearance, sampling variability
note: Same molecule, oral route (approved 1987), CF not bronchiectasis; target field is the drug name; true target bacterial gyrase/topoisomerase IV in airway pathogens.

anchor_quote: Haloperidol (9 mg/day) caused Parkinsonism, reduced tardive dyskinesias and increased the HVA concentration in the CSF.
anchor_detail: Double-blind crossover, 8 schizophrenic men: D2 antagonist haloperidol raised lumbar CSF HVA; agonist apomorphine lowers it (Levy 1984, Przedborski 1995)
other_movers: L-DOPA, MAO/COMT inhibitors, probenecid, clozapine, age, disease state (PD, Tourette)
note: 1974 Sedvall/Fyro chlorpromazine CSF-HVA papers title-only; apomorphine cut ventricular CSF HVA 21% (PMID 7885353). D1/D2 not separable.

anchor_quote: The expanded T cell pool was polyclonal, as demonstrated by increases in both T4+ and T8+ T cell subsets, and activated, with statistically significant increases in IL 2 receptor
anchor_detail: rIL-2 infusion, 30 advanced-cancer patients: lymphocytosis with CD4+/CD8+ expansion; Caligiuri 1993 (PMID 7678599) NK expansion via IL-2R p75 (IL2RB)
other_movers: IL-15, IL-12/IL-18, checkpoint blockade, viral infection, G-CSF or steroid-withdrawal rebound
note: IL2RB hypomorphic LOF (2019, PMID 31040184) paradoxically expands immature CD56bright NK; IL-2 also signals via IL2RA/IL2RG.

anchor_quote: SNPs at 2q12 (rs1420101), 2q13 (rs12619285), 3q21 (rs4857855), 5q31 (rs4143832) and 12q24 (rs3184504) reached genome-wide significance
anchor_detail: GWAS of blood eosinophil counts, 9,392 Icelanders plus 17,330 replication; 5q31 rs4143832 sits in the RAD50-IL5 locus
other_movers: Parasites, atopy/asthma, corticosteroids, IL-33/ST2, GATA2, SH2B3, drug reactions, HES
note: Abstract names 5q31 only; IL5 assignment from paper's locus table (full text not accessed). Earlier prior_drug: mepolizumab cut eosinophils, Leckie 2000.

anchor_quote: Chk1-inhibition triggered rapid, pan-nuclear phosphorylation of histone H2AX, p53, Smc1, replication protein A, and Chk1 itself in human S-phase cells.
anchor_detail: In-vitro human cell lines: CHK1 inhibition (UCN-01, CEP-3891, siRNA) induces gamma-H2AX via ATR; no independent human anchor found
other_movers: Any genotoxic chemo/radiation, ATR/WEE1/PARP inhibitors, replication stress, apoptosis, age
note: MK-8776 phase I (2015, PMID 25605849) used only a K562 ex-vivo plasma gamma-H2AX bioassay; prexasertib's own 2016 trial measured blood PD without direct CHK1 readout.

anchor_quote: Monocyte counts were reduced by >90% 24 to 48 hours after a single injection of liposomal alendronate, returning to basal levels at 6 days.
anchor_detail: Hypercholesterolemic rabbits, iliac stenting: liposomal alendronate transiently depletes circulating monocytes; no independent human study found
other_movers: Clodronate liposomes, glucocorticoids, infection/ACS, diabetes, CSF1R blockade, circadian variation
note: Depletion needs liposomal delivery into phagocytes; free alendronate does not deplete human monocytes. BLAST 2013 (NCT00739466) is the program's own trial.

anchor_quote: the selective MAPK/extracellular signal-regulated kinase-1 inhibitor PD-98059 decreased interleukin-1beta and tumor necrosis factor-alpha production in response to sMALP-2
anchor_detail: In-vitro human monocytes/macrophages: MEK inhibitor PD-98059 cuts IL-1beta/TNF-alpha; LPS-TNF confirmed in primary human monocytes (PMID 10417144, 1999)
other_movers: p38 inhibitors, glucocorticoids, JAK inhibitors, NF-kB blockers, endotoxin tolerance, statins
note: ARRY-438162 2006 healthy-volunteer SAD (Array press, 20 subjects) showed 50 to >95% IL-1beta blockade but no direct pERK/MEK readout found; same program.

anchor_quote: Results of biomarkers studies (activated T cell markers, ribonucleic acid [RNA] expression, and serum biomolecules) indicated that BMS-663513 elicited biologic activity with doses as low as 0.3 mg/kg.
anchor_detail: Urelumab (BMS-663513) phase I-II, 115 solid-tumour patients (Sznol, ASCO 2008): activated CD8 T-cell markers, IFN-inducible RNA, serum markers
other_movers: Checkpoint blockade, IL-2/IL-15 agonists, OX40/GITR agonists, infection, vaccines, chemotherapy
note: Primary 2008 ASCO abstract (Sznol) inaccessible; quoted from 2013 review read in full. Utomilumab abstract does not name its biomarkers.

anchor_quote: Li+ treatment of Drosophila S2 cells and rat PC12 cells induces accumulation of cytoplasmic Armadillo/beta-catenin, demonstrating that Li+ can mimic Wingless signalling in intact cells
anchor_detail: GSK-3 inhibition (lithium) stabilises cytoplasmic beta-catenin in cultured cells; no human study links beta-catenin levels to measured GSK3 inhibition
other_movers: Wnt ligands, APC/CTNNB1/AXIN mutations, PI3K/Akt signalling, lithium/valproate
note: Only human beta-catenin data are LY2090314's own PBMC PD (Gray 2015, Rizzieri 2016); lithium-treated-patient beta-catenin never measured; GSK3A/B not distinguished

anchor_quote: The percentage of Ki-67+ CD4+ T cells started to increase early (day 8) and the Ki-67+ CD8+ T cells later (day 15) after anti-OX40
anchor_detail: Phase 1 of murine agonist anti-OX40 9B12 in 30 advanced-cancer patients: Ki-67+ CD4/CD8 T cells rose, mAb binding shown on PBMC ex vivo
other_movers: vaccination, infection, checkpoint blockade (anti-CTLA-4/PD-1), IL-2, 4-1BB agonists raise Ki-67+ T cells
note: Confirmed by MEDI0562 (2020) and GSK3174998 (>80% RO, 2023); OX40+ cell loss may reflect epitope masking by drug; SL-279252 is PD-L1/OX40 bispecific

anchor_quote: we identified a CXCR2 frameshift mutation in a pedigree with congenital neutropenia that abolished ligand-induced CXCR2 signal transduction and chemotaxis
anchor_detail: CXCR2 (not CXCR1) loss of function: exome-array missense variants lower WBC in 31,340 people; frameshift pedigree with congenital neutropenia
other_movers: chemotherapy, G-CSF (up), infection/stress (up), Duffy-null ACKR1, corticosteroids, many drugs
note: Wrong-target suspicion: ANC fall is CXCR2 pharmacology (CXCR2-selective AZD5069 2015, SB-656933 ex-vivo 2011); navarixin is dual CXCR1/2; no CXCR1-specific human anchor

anchor_quote: The present study shows that loss of function of GPR54 is a cause of IHH
anchor_detail: Consanguineous family, 5 siblings with isolated hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (low LH/FSH, sex steroids), homozygous GPR54/KISS1R 155-nt deletion; Seminara NEJM 2003 concurrent
other_movers: GnRH agonists/antagonists, LH/hCG, androgen therapy, age, obesity, illness, opioids, circadian rhythm
note: Direct human pharmacology followed: kisspeptin-54 infusion raised LH, FSH and testosterone in 6 men (Dhillo 2005, 10.1210/jc.2005-1468)
